components.css: .ds-install { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.375rem; min-height: 3.3rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #ffb000); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--color-primary, #ffb000); color: var(--color-primary-content, #171a1b); font: 600 1.3rem/1 var(--display, 'Rajdhani', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; touch-action: manipulation; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-install svg { width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-install:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #ffb000); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-install:active { translate: 0 0.5px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-install:hover { background: #ffc044; border-color: #ffc044; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-install { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-copy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-height: 2.3rem; height: 2.3rem; padding: 0 0.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #727c7e); border-radius: 3px; background: #1a1e1f; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); font: 600 1rem/1 var(--display, 'Rajdhani', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; touch-action: manipulation; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-copy svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #ffb000); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-copy:active { translate: 0 0.5px; } .ds-copy:disabled { pointer-events: none; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-copy:hover { background: #1a1e1f; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-copy { min-height: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; font-size: 1.05rem; padding-inline: 0.8rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-copy { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-reading-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding-block: 0.3rem; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); font: 600 1.1rem/1.5 var(--display, 'Rajdhani', sans-serif); text-decoration-line: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.23em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-reading-link svg { width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-reading-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #ffb000); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-reading-link:hover { color: var(--amber, #ffb000); } } @media (max-width: 850px) { .ds-reading-link { padding-inline: 0.5rem; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-reading-link { padding-block: 0.5rem; } }

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Plain section links and a divided source link from index.astro .site-header nav. Narrow layouts retain the source link without inventing a menu.
components.html: InstallThe boundaryCreditsGitHub
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); font: 600 1.2rem/1.4 var(--display, 'Rajdhani', sans-serif); } .ds-nav-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 0.23em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-source { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #41494b); padding-left: 2rem; } .ds-nav svg { width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #ffb000); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-nav-link:hover { text-decoration-line: underline; } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--amber, #ffb000); } } @media (max-width: 850px) { .ds-nav { gap: 1.2rem; } .ds-nav-source { padding-left: 1.2rem; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-nav { gap: 0; } .ds-nav > a:not(.ds-nav-source) { display: none; } .ds-nav-source { padding-left: 0; border: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; gap: 0.3rem; } }

components.name: Ruled disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary specimen from index.astro and site.css .collapse. The installed daisyUI plugin owns content-transition mechanics; the chevron has no transition.
components.html:
Updating or removing the provider

After updating your checkout, run pnpm build again. Pi uses that checkout directly.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #41494b); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #41494b); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); } .ds-disclosure-title { position: relative; display: block; min-height: 3.5rem; font: 600 1.3rem/1.4 var(--display, 'Rajdhani', sans-serif); padding: 1rem 2.5rem 1rem 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure-title::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure-title::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; inset-inline-end: 1.4rem; display: block; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; transform: translateY(-100%) rotate(45deg); transform-origin: 75% 75%; box-shadow: 2px 2px; pointer-events: none; transition: none; } .ds-disclosure-title:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #ffb000); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-disclosure-content { padding: 0; font: 400 1.125rem/1.55 var(--body, 'Barlow', sans-serif); } .ds-disclosure[open] > .ds-disclosure-content { padding: 0 0 1rem; } .ds-disclosure-content p { color: var(--muted, #b4bbbc); max-width: 75ch; margin: 0; } .ds-disclosure-content code { font: 0.88em/1.7 ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-disclosure[open] > .ds-disclosure-title::after { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(225deg); } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-disclosure-title { font-size: 1.2rem; } .ds-disclosure-content { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.css: .ds-code-panel { border: 1px solid var(--steel, #727c7e); border-radius: 3px; background: #101314; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); } .ds-code-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #41494b); background: #23292a; font: 600 1.1rem/1.3 var(--display, 'Rajdhani', sans-serif); } .ds-code-block { margin: 0; padding: 1.25rem; overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; scrollbar-color: var(--steel, #727c7e) #101314; } .ds-code-block code { font: 400 0.875rem/1.7 ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; color: var(--ink, #f2f2ef); overflow-wrap: normal; } .ds-code-block:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #ffb000); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-code-footnote { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #41494b); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } .ds-code-footnote p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #b4bbbc); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.55 var(--body, 'Barlow', sans-serif); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-code-toolbar { padding: 0.75rem; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-code-block { padding: 1rem; } .ds-code-footnote { padding: 0.75rem; } .ds-code-footnote p { font-size: 0.875rem; } }

narrative.overview:
Condensed white lettering sits on matte charcoal flaps inside a brushed, recessed steel bezel. Amber marks actions and attention. Below the board, thin rules and aligned columns carry the reading rhythm without repeating the hero's material treatment.

The system pairs a physical display with plain, readable documentation. Painter-generated shaded raster artwork supplies the board's material detail; live text supplies its message. Controls stay compact and nearly square. The board is static, so its mechanical appearance does not delay reading.

This record applies to the static website under `site/`, not to Pi or provider runtime interfaces. The approved world is concourse/departure-board, `seed273011f1`. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) owns product truth; the [landing-page surface brief](site/.impeccable/surfaces/site-src-pages-index-astro.md) owns its story and composition. [site.css](site/src/styles/site.css), especially `:root` and the `concourse` theme, owns the implemented values. [index.astro](site/src/pages/index.astro) owns markup and accessible labels. The frontmatter records their visual contract; it is not a separate runtime theme.
keyCharacteristics: Shaded charcoal flaps and a brushed steel bezel.
Condensed display lettering with a separate body face.
Amber controls and attention marks against dark neutrals.
Ruled reading sections with responsive columns.
Live text, visible keyboard focus and manual copy recovery.

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Use amber for an action or an attention state. Ordinary body text and structural rules stay neutral.

rules.name: The Live Lettering Rule
rules.body: Keep board letters as text. The heading supplies one complete accessible label, while its decorative rows are hidden from assistive technology. Material artwork contains no message.

rules.name: The Ruled Reading Rule
rules.body: Separate related reading groups with thin neutral rules and alignment. Reserve the raster enclosure for the signature board rather than wrapping every section in a material card.

rules.name: The Material Owns Shading Rule
rules.body: Let the accepted raster artwork carry grain, recesses and hinge shading. CSS supplies layout, solid fallbacks, the mounting shadow and the seam through live letters.

dos: Do keep Rajdhani for display and controls, Barlow for prose, and monospace for actual commands.
Do preserve live board lettering, its complete accessible label and the accepted raster material owners.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and leave a manual selection path when clipboard access fails.
Do use rules and responsive columns to organize reading content without repeating the hero enclosure.
donts: Don't bake the headline into artwork or let decorative rows replace the accessible heading.
Don't re-create raster grain, recessed edges or hinges with CSS gradients and procedural overlays.
Don't treat synthesized sidecar tonal ramps or unused theme aliases as additional brand accents.
Don't infer an input, chip, modal or generic card system from this landing page.
